label: Food
title: Eat like Nairobi.
sub: Nyama choma joints, Swahili kitchens, cafés and late-night bites. Reserve or order straight from the restaurant.

title: Get there. Get back.
sub: Choose where you are going and we open Uber or Bolt with the trip ready. You see the fare and pay inside their app.
